meta.name: fii-dii-flow-tracker
meta.description: Track and analyze FII/DII daily buy/sell flows in Indian markets. Use when user asks about institutional flows, FII selling/buying trends, DII activity, or institutional impact on Nifty/market direction.

copy.tagline: 追踪印度市场机构资金流向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果关注印度股市机构买卖动向
copy.tagline_en: Track institutional fund flows in Indian markets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you track FII/DII activity in Indian equities

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询印度股市外资（FII）和内资（DII）每日买卖数据，分析资金流向趋势，并与 Nifty 50 指数走势关联，给出机构持仓判断。
howto.when: 当你提到“FII”、“DII”、“机构资金”、“外资买卖”等关键词，或询问机构资金对 Nifty 的影响时触发。

say.text: 今天 FII 和 DII 的净买卖数据是多少？
say.note: Claude 会搜索最新数据并展示。

say.text: 最近一周 FII 是净买入还是净卖出？
say.note: Claude 会分析趋势并给出结论。

say.text: FII 资金流向与 Nifty 走势有什么关联？
say.note: Claude 会计算相关性并解释。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query daily FII/DII buy/sell data for Indian markets, analyze flow trends, correlate with Nifty 50 movement, and assess institutional positioning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "FII", "DII", "institutional flow", "foreign investor", or ask about institutional impact on Nifty.

say_en.text: What are today's FII and DII net buy/sell figures?
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and display the latest data.

say_en.text: Has FII been net buying or selling over the past week?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the trend and give a conclusion.

say_en.text: How do FII flows correlate with Nifty movement?
say_en.note: Claude will compute correlation and explain.
